question: Should a content-verified Android APK be admitted as a host-local safe document when `tools.fs.workspaceOnly` is disabled?
rationale: This changes the host-read attachment trust boundary for executable package archives; the mechanical classifier repairs do not determine whether that category should be allowed.

options.title: Allow verified APKs only
options.body: Accept APKs only after content verification, while retaining existing MIME behavior for partial-buffer and path-only callers.

options.title: Keep APKs outside host-read documents
options.body: Reject APKs at the host-read boundary and avoid adding a new executable-package exception.

recommendation.title: Allow verified APKs only
recommendation.body: Accept APKs only after content verification, while retaining existing MIME behavior for partial-buffer and path-only callers.
